Flaming Sphere

(Player's Handbook v.3.5, p. 232)

Evocation (Creation) [Fire]
Level: Druid 2, Warmage 2 (Fire)
Components: V, S, M
Casting Time: 1 standard action
Range: Medium
Effect: 5-ft. sphere
Duration: 1 round/level
Saving Throw: Reflex negates
